annotations.title: Read a published AI Outreach Playbook

description: The complete published AI Outreach Playbooks: Revopush (developer infrastructure), LeadToCall (sales software) and SLSBMB AI's own fundraising playbook. Without arguments: every published playbook, then Revopush's goal, audience estimate and audiences; with playbook: that playbook; with audience_number: that audience's research, why the sequence works, the current opener, two follow-ups and targeting. Use it to show what a playbook contains before anyone buys.

audience_number.description: The audience to read in full, as numbered in that playbook's overview.

playbook.description: Which published playbook to open: revopush (default), leadtocall or slsbmb-fundraising.
